name: Thumbnail Agent
description: Internal thumbnail generator with brand-specific templates and fonts, script-based image generation, optional person-reference edits to preserve facial identity while changing clothing, expressions, and scenes, and PNG download.

optional_environment_variables.OPENAI_REFERENCE_IMAGE_MODEL: Optional person-reference edit model; defaults to OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL when unset.

person_reference_notes: The actual reference photo is supplied to visual planning and directly to the OpenAI Images edits endpoint.
Reference edits use high input fidelity for gpt-image-1 and gpt-image-1.5; gpt-image-2 handles high input fidelity automatically.
Use the existing server OpenAI API key; person-reference edits do not require a separate key.
Outfits, expressions, poses, and scenes may change while preserving facial identity is the goal.
Compare generated faces with the actual photo before use. Exact identity consistency is not guaranteed or automatically validated.
security_notes: Do not share your personal OpenAI API key.
Each copied app should use its own OpenAI API key or a separate company-managed key.
Anyone with access to the hosted link can use the app unless they add their own access control.
usage_notes: Leverage Edu uses three headline lines, with the last highlighted turquoise; use MY JOURNEY TO | UNIVERSITY OF | SALFORD to choose the line breaks.
Optionally upload a photo of the people whose facial identity should be preserved; outfits, expressions, and scenes may change.
Review the generated people against the actual reference photo when one was supplied.
